newsitem.title: USA: Baby Bells to sell joint research arm - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Baby Bells to sell joint research arm - WSJ.

text.p: The seven regional "Baby Bells" are close to announcing the sale of their jointly owned research arm, Bell Communications Research, to Science Applications International Corp for $700 million, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
The sale of Bellcore, as it is known, would end a 12-year-old cooperation that began with the breakup of the old AT&T. It could be announced as early as this week, the article said.
Bellcore is owned by Ameritech Corp, Bell Atlantic Corp, BellSouth Corp, NYNEX Corp, Pacific Telesis Group, SBC Communications Inc, and U S West Communications Group.
